Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent misidentified monday.com’s current C-suite and IPO-time C-suite by relying on unverified third-party aggregators (e.g., Craft.co and WSJ “company people”) instead of the official investor relations management team page listed in the search results. This led to introducing incorrect or dubious entries (e.g., “Amit Mathrani” as CRO, “Oren Stern” as CMO, “Michal Aharon” as CPO) and assuming only three C-suite members at IPO, resulting in an incorrect comparison and wrong final list.
